51317991.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to GST-tagged PLK1 PBD (327 to 603 residues) (unknown origin) by surface plasmon resonance analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: Surface Plasmon Resonance (SPR) Analysis. The binding affinity of tested compounds to Plk1 was analyzed using SPR Biacore T200 instrument. Plk1 was immobilized on a CMS sensor chip through standard amine-coupling procedure at 25 °C in running buffer contains 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.2, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% TWEEN-20, and 1 mM EDTA. Approximately 1200 response units (RU) of Plk1 was immobilized on the chip to measure the binding affinity of compounds. Series of compounds dilutions with 5% DMSO in running buffer were injected into the channels. Regeneration was achieved by 1 min washing with the running buffer after injection. The equilibrium dissociation constant Kd of the compounds were determined with the Hill equation. The SPR dose-response curves of the compounds are shown in Supporting information, Figure S4.

analyte.description: Series of compounds dilutions with 5% DMSO in running buffer

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM HEPES, pH 7.2, 150 mM NaCl, 0.05% TWEEN-20, and 1 mM EDTA
